queries: SELECT * FROM customers
SELECT * FROM orders
SELECT * FROM payments
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers
SELECT COUNT(*) AS payment_count FROM payments

SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS purchasing_customers,
  SUM(amount) AS total_order_amount,
  AVG(amount) AS average_order_value,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS completed_order_amount
FROM orders

SELECT order_month, order_count, purchasing_customers, total_order_amount, average_order_value, completed_order_amount
FROM monthly_order_summary
ORDER BY order_month

SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount
FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id

GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name
ORDER BY total_order_amount DESC, c.customer_id ASC
LIMIT 10

SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(amount) AS total_order_amount
FROM orders 
GROUP BY status
ORDER BY total_order_amount DESC, status
SELECT COUNT(*) AS issues FROM orders o LEFT JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.customer_id IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) AS issues FROM payments p LEFT JOIN orders o ON p.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_id IS NULL

WITH payment_totals AS (SELECT order_id, SUM(amount) AS payment_amount FROM payments GROUP BY order_id)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS issues FROM orders o
LEFT JOIN payment_totals pt ON o.order_id = pt.order_id
WHERE ABS(o.amount - pt.payment_amount) > 0.000001
   OR (o.amount IS NULL AND pt.payment_amount IS NOT NULL)
   OR (o.amount IS NOT NULL AND pt.payment_amount IS NULL)
